decoys.span: All notices under this SOW shall be sent to: for the Buyer, the Head of Procurement, Acme Retail India Private Limited, Bengaluru; for the Supplier, the Contracts Manager, CleanSpace Global Facilities Pte. Ltd., Singapore.

decoys.span: The aggregate liability of each party shall not exceed the fees paid in the prior twelve (12) months.
decoys.reason: Acceptable: trailing-12-month fees cap is the preferred position.

decoys.span: The Supplier shall indemnify the Buyer for third-party claims arising from the Services, subject to the limitation of liability in Clause 5, except that indemnities for data breach shall remain uncapped.
decoys.reason: Acceptable: the indemnity is subject to the cap; only data-breach claims stay uncapped — the playbook's preferred position.
